description: Unauthorized Device Registration An attacker could attempt to register unauthorized devices by intercepting the device registration process or compromising the certificate provisioning workflow. An attacker registers a malicious device using stolen or forged certificates, gaining access to send data into the system and potentially exfiltrate information about other devices.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
recommendation: Implement strong device provisioning process with unique X.509 certificates
recommendation: Enforce strict device registration policies

references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
recommendation: Implement strict S3 bucket policies and IAM roles

description: Insufficient Access Control for Data Visualization Lack of proper access controls in QuickSight could allow users to view data from devices or organizations they shouldn't have access to.
